subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmepayments.com>, Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Jenna / Luis —

Thanks again for taking time today to run the buying committee through the demo. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on timeline and owners: 

Summary of what we covered
- Core ask: serve low-latency conversational recommendations inside the Acme merchant portal (sub-200ms p95 target) and scale to ~5k monthly active merchants.
- Key capabilities demonstrated: streaming responses, prefix caching for repeated merchant queries, and RBAC + audit logs for compliance.
- Pilot scope suggested: 500 merchants, 30-day performance & cost evaluation, includes integration support and weekly check-ins.

Stakeholder map (as we understand it)
- Economic buyer: Jenna Park (Head of Product) — owns final sign-off and ROI.
- Technical lead: Luis Ortega (Director, Engineering) — integration and SLO alignment.
- Security/legal: procurement@acmepayments.com + internal counsel (TBD) — needs SOC2 evidence, data residency and retention policy.
- Procurement: procurement@acmepayments.com — handles PO/contracting and procurement checklist.

Open items / asks from Acme
1) Confirm economic buyer and final decision timeline (you mentioned "end of August"?)
2) Security checklist: confirm whether we should route SOC2 and architecture diagrams to procurement or legal first.
3) Procurement terms: any required PO language or SLA minimums we should know up front.

What we will do next
- Share a draft SOW and pricing sheet for pilot (attached).
- Share SOC2 Type II and our standard DPA + security architecture doc (attached).
- Rafael (cc'd) will set up a short procurement/legal enable call and provide a contract redline path.

Proposed next steps / timings
- Procurement & legal review call: Can we schedule a 30-45m slot next week? Rafael / Neha available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.
- Target decision checkpoint: internal Acme exec review by 2026-08-25 (flexible).

Attachments: Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf (stub), Redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (stub), SOC2-type2-2025.pdf (stub)

Thanks — I'll follow up with calendar invites once I hear which day/time works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

---

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmepayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@acmepayments.com>
Cc: procurement@acmepayments.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — great demo and very helpful recap. A few clarifications from Acme's side: 

1) Decision timeline: I can confirm we are targeting an exec decision by the week of Aug 24; the final sign-off will likely come from me after one final review with our CFO.

2) Stakeholders: correct mapping overall. For legal review please send SOC2 and any standard DPA language to procurement@acmepayments.com — they will triage and loop in our counsel (Kate). For technical SLOs Luis will own the integration details.

3) Procurement asks:
- We need a pricing sheet broken out by pilot vs production (monthly committed vs on-demand).
- Standard PO language: please include our standard indemnity clause and an SLA with service credits for p99 > 1s. If you have a template, attach it.

4) Security question: Are you able to provide network diagrams and details about encryption in transit/at rest? Also curious about key management options (KMS/HSM) for private deployments.

Attaching the procurement intake form for reference (procurement@acmepayments.com).

If you can get the draft SOW, pricing, SOC2 and a short architecture diagram over by end of day Thurs (16 Jul) that would be ideal — procurement will start triage then.

Appreciate it — Jenna
Head of Product | Acme Payments
jenna.park@acmepayments.com | +1 347-555-0228
